value.rationale: The complete Frobenius cycle-type (4) hyperplane-section statistic in the smallest finite field is a natural arithmetic Bertini invariant. It gives exact incidence counts and sharp 4666/6254 nonexistence/existence partition across all smooth degree-four plane curves, far beyond the known single endpoint class. This is not a routine substitution of a known trace histogram, since curve point counts do not determine these line-by-line Frobenius cycle types.
